_doc: Pi-IR projection of tool_args_truncated/messages_sse.json. THE WIRE IS TRUNCATED MID-JSON. The two harnesses diverge on recovery policy: (a) pi accumulates partialJson AND parses live via parsePartialJson(), recovering a best-effort args Record like {"command":"ls"} and emitting a toolCall block; pi's stop_reason on output.stopReason is whatever the wire carried (here 'tool_use'). (b) XLI keeps the raw partial_json bytes verbatim on the FunctionCall.arguments string AND detects the JSON-parse failure to OVERRIDE the Completed envelope's stop_reason from 'tool_use' to 'max_tokens' (S-004 retry signal). The IR-level divergence is documented as ASYMMETRIC; the cross-wire fence here uses _xli_full_sequence to lock XLI's verbatim-bytes shape, and the test fn additionally asserts the stop_reason override. Closes RI-017 (BLOCKS_PROD — Truncated tool args).
_asymmetry_recovery_policy: pi recovers via parsePartialJson; XLI keeps raw bytes + stop_reason='max_tokens' override (S-004)
_uses_strict_order: XLI keeps invalid JSON in arguments verbatim; normalize_for_equiv leaves invalid JSON as String (no semantic parse); the would-be pi projection cannot be expressed via project(output_content) since pi's recovered shape ({command:'ls'}) is different from XLI's raw partial bytes.
